verdict.rationale: Devin's own docs site publishes an llms.txt (confirmed via probe HTTP 200) with a structured index of agent-oriented markdown docs, and individual pages are also available in .md form, meaning an AI-native user/agent can point at these directly for machine-readable documentation. missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of agents actually consuming llms.txt in practice, and no explicit vendor guidance encouraging users to point their own agents at it.
